assessment: Sensory cilia are highly specialized organelles whose development and function requires complex machinery. In this important work, the authors use a convincing set of genetic, bioinformatic, and biochemical approaches in C. elegans to demonstrate that the forkhead transcription factor FKH-8 acts cooperatively with the RFX factor DAF-19 to activate the expression of many cilium genes. These findings indicate that forkhead factors have an ancient, conserved role in the development of sensory cilia, making this paper of interest to a variety of developmental and cell biologists.
